# judo-meta-query

> Defines the Query metamodel — an EMF Ecore model representing expression-based transformation logic for generating RDBMS queries, part of the JUDO ecosystem.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Eclipse EMF (Ecore) metamodel framework
- Maven 3.9.4+ with Tycho 4.0.13 (Eclipse integration), 6 modules
- Distributed as Eclipse plugin, standalone Maven artifact, and OSGi bundle
- Uses MWE2 code generation and Epsilon EVL validation
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with metamodel class diagram and build commands
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide — build commands, directory structure, coding conventions, and key configuration files
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, code generation workflow, and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Branching strategy and CI/CD workflow documentation

## Modules — Core

- [model/model/query.ecore](model/model/query.ecore): Ecore metamodel definition — the source of truth for the Query model
- [model/pom.xml](model/pom.xml): Core Eclipse plugin — Ecore model, generated EMF classes, hand-written runtime utilities, and Epsilon validation rules

## Modules — Testing

- [model-test/pom.xml](model-test/pom.xml): JUnit 5 tests for model validation, loading, and execution context
- [osgi-itest/pom.xml](osgi-itest/pom.xml): OSGi integration tests using Pax Exam with Karaf container

## Modules — Distribution

- [osgi/pom.xml](osgi/pom.xml): Repackages the model as an OSGi bundle for non-Eclipse consumers
- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature definition for plugin installation
- [site/pom.xml](site/pom.xml): Eclipse P2 update site for distribution

## Depends on

- [osgi-utils](../../runtime/osgi-utils): OSGi utility library — lifecycle tracking, config monitoring, ranked services
- [epsilon-runtime](../../tools/epsilon-runtime): Eclipse Epsilon runtime for Maven and OSGi environments

## Used by

- [judo-platform](../../runtime/judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-runtime-core](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core): Multi-module runtime engine — data access, business logic, REST, and security
- [judo-runtime-core-esm-itest](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core-esm-itest): Integration tests for ESM-to-RDBMS transformation pipeline
- [judo-services](../../runtime/judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI/CD build pipeline
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): Manual release workflow
